# GEMBA IT — gembait.com

> GEMBA IT is the technology division of GEMBA EOOD, a software company in Varna, Bulgaria
> (VAT BG208656371). We build, deploy and maintain software for business clients: Linux
> infrastructure, Node.js backends, React applications, payment integrations and monitoring.
> Every engagement starts with a written offer; work is invoiced in EUR and payable by card
> or bank transfer.

## Services & pricing (https://gembait.com/en/pricing)

- Linux Servers & DevOps — from €490: installation, configuration and hardening of a Linux
  server (SSH key-only, UFW, fail2ban, unattended updates). Additional services (web, FTP,
  Samba, print, e-mail, SQL servers) are priced separately.
- Backend & APIs — from €900: API design plus a basic working API; everything beyond is
  quoted by complexity and scope.
- Database Architecture — from €600: design and creation of a core database (PostgreSQL,
  MongoDB, MariaDB).
- React Websites — personal from €490, corporate from €900. React only — no PHP/WordPress.
- Payment Integrations — from €700: Stripe/PayPal checkout and webhooks on the client's own
  processor accounts.
- Monitoring Systems — from €600: dashboards, alert rules, notification channels.
- Admin Panels — from €1,200: roles, permissions, CRUD workflows, audit logging.
- Access Control — from €1,500: check-in/check-out software and attendance reporting.
- Video Surveillance — from €800: NVR/camera configuration and alarm notifications.
- MVP Development — from €1,900: scoping workshop, core features, deployment, one iteration.
- Web3 & Blockchain Development — from €1,200: one EVM contract up to 100 lines with tests
  and deploy script; larger scopes agreed individually.
- Smart Contract Audit — from €900: automated analysis of one contract up to 100 lines with
  a documented report; manual review quoted separately.

Consulting: €100/hour. Blockchain consulting: €150/hour.
Monthly support plans: Basic €199/mo, Standard €499/mo, Priority €980/mo.
Services outside the standard packages are agreed after a preliminary consultation:
https://gembait.com/en/contact

## Products (https://gembait.com/en/products)

- GembaKitchen — live SaaS: AI-assisted kitchen operations for restaurants (inventory,
  recipes, food-cost). Billed by card via GembaPay.
- GEMBA RECORDS Radio — free 24/7 web radio, three stations.
- GembaPay — payment gateway unifying Stripe and PayPal behind one API (developer preview).
- GembaTicket — free online ticketing platform (test mode).
- GembaPass — access passes and memberships SaaS (test mode).
- Permitiv — industrial permit-to-work platform (in development).
- EduChain — educational platform for schools (test mode; runs on a test network only).
- GembaBlockchain — a public research testnet; no mainnet, no coin sale, the test coin has
  no monetary value.
